# Bundled typefaces

Newsreader (roman and italic) and DM Sans are bundled as Latin WOFF2 files so decks render offline without contacting a font service. Newsreader includes its optical-size and weight axes; DM Sans includes weights 400–700.

Downloaded from Google Fonts on November 13, 2026. Upstream sources and licenses:

- [Newsreader](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/newsreader) — `OFL-newsreader.txt`.
- [DM Sans](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmsans) — `OFL-dmsans.txt`.

The font files retain their original names internally and are distributed with their SIL Open Font License notices.
